home.kicker: A feedback adventure in twelve notebooks
home.question: How does a machine keep itself where it's supposed to be?
intro: This started in a shower. One of us turned the knob, got scalded, turned it back, froze, and turned it again. Then we wondered: a little drone can hover perfectly still in the wind with no brain at all. **How?**

These are our notebooks from working it out, including every wrong turn. We start from zero: no calculus needed. By the end you'll know why the **Laplace transform** exists, what **poles** really are, and you'll tune a **PID** controller that beats your own hands.

cast.mika: Asks the questions everyone is secretly thinking. Pushes every slider to max "just to see".
cast.theo: Won't accept a trick until he knows *why* it works. Great at finding the bug.
cast.june: Builds things. Always asks: "can we try it on the drone?"
